arguments.body: Hi Kendall, Meadow Works emailed today to say they attended the shower at Willowmere Road, found a problem with the mixer, cleaned and greased it, and that hot and cold are now both running. That is the contractor's report; we are checking it with the tenant. They said an invoice and photos were attached, but they did not reach us, so I can't yet tell you the amount. I've asked them to resend it and will pass on the figure as soon as we have it. Please don't pay anything until you hear from us. We'll update you by Wednesday 4 June.
